main_text.head: CAPVT IV. De Trinitate Personarum in Divina Essentia.
I.
main_text.p: QUotquot hodie dispersi vivunt Judæi, negant omnes ore præfracto divinæ Essentiæ Trinitatem, quam ɯɥ nominant, à Majoribus discedentes, summæ veritatis Doctoribus, tum ante Messiam ex Prophetarum vaticiniis, tum post Messiæ adventum ex antiqua residua Catechesi, cognitionisque Clavi, observantibus bene multis, maxime Raymundo in Pugione Fidei per Voysinium edito, & Galatino læpe cum Hebræorum scriptis conferendo, quod aliquando cespitet, in Arcanis veritatis Religionis Catholicæ; Detestanturque Posteri præposteri Prisonarum voces, accusantque Christianos, quod legem pervertant sacrosanctam, quod יהוה Essentiæ Unitatem destruant, tollantque, quod tres habeant, quos venerentur.

page.notes: Greek or Hebrew words in the text ("ɯɥ" and the Hebrew divine name) are rendered only approximately; the Hebrew letters were printed and could not be read exactly. Some words ("Voysinium", "cespitet", "Prisonarum") are doubtful. The last word "tur" is a catchword-like continuation at the line end and is included in the paragraph.
